title: Mod Items
description: A plugin which marks special items as mod items to give to your players.
body:
# Mod Items

A lightweight plugin that allows staff members to label items as rare mod items using `/moditem <edition>`.  
This adds special tag and prevents the item from being placed, interacted with.

## Features
- Interaction/placement prevention
- MiniMessage support for rich text formatting
- Vault support for display names

## Usage
Hold an item in your main hand and run:

```
/moditem <edition>
```

Example:

```
/moditem One Of A Kind
```

## Permissions
- `moditems.command.moditem`: Allows the use of the `/moditem` command.
